verdict.rationale: Unleash ships an official MCP server (@unleash/mcp) documented to let LLM-powered coding assistants create and manage feature flags following best practices, and a probe confirms the docs' MCP endpoint completes a handshake, corroborating the integration is real and agent-reachable. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on demonstration of the flag-management MCP server itself in use (only the docs MCP endpoint was probed), and it requires local setup with a PAT rather than being zero-config.
